capture_scope.excludes: Other stack/ABI/FS/cookie reads and caller preflight

limits: Only the four genuine index insertions of each empty manager constructor are qualified; no synthetic provider or altered source opcode.
Index trace filters canonical allocation addresses, the actual caller key_ref and deallocator globals. Stack arguments, spills, cookie and FS/SEH scaffolding are excluded.
Writes are normalized to bytes; reads retain exact native width and order.
Native normal-return behavior only; host read-error recovery is tested separately in Rust.
